_comment: S-C section-trust fixture (synthetic hand-pinned missions, same harness-internal test worlds as section_space.json - sections are named s-* on purpose, the module only ever sees feed strings). Covers the S-C mask-update rules: backwards victim ring (named argmax, anonymous group disjunctive, Death deduction, wiped/unseeded honest bases), the table-owned door transit hypothesis (hypothesis grade, fact rail untouched), the EXPLAIN evidence chain (Ereignis+Regel, coordinate-free) and the coarse low-skill reading. Expect blocks recorded ONCE via --record and reviewed line by line; the laws themselves are hand-pinned in SectionsSectionTrust.cs.

cases.name: st_ring_argmax_sharp
cases._comment: Named victim, single-candidate mask: strong = the victim argmax of its OWN mask; weak = every other KNOWN section as distributed disjunctiv, ordered by lower-bound distance (s-b 1, s-c 2). Same round 1 everywhere so the belief is undilated - the sharp case.
